vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: extract-memories
Version: 3.0.5

The 'extract-memories' skill is designed to automatically summarize conversation highlights and store them in a structured local memory system (memory/topics/). It requires FileRead/Write and session history permissions to function, which are consistent with its stated purpose of analyzing past messages and updating index files. The instructions in SKILL.md include specific constraints to prevent the storage of redundant or sensitive technical data (e.g., source code, git history), and there are no indicators of data exfiltration, remote code execution, or malicious intent.

llm.summary: The skill's requested file access and session reads match its stated purpose (extracting and persisting conversation 'memories'); nothing in the SKILL.md asks for unrelated credentials, installs, or network access.

dimensions.detail: The name/description claim (extract/persist conversation memories) aligns with the actions the skill requests: reading session history and MEMORY.md and writing topic files and heartbeat-state.json under memory/. No unrelated credentials, binaries, or external services are required.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructions are narrowly focused on detecting conversation end, extracting summary items, writing topic files to memory/topics/, and updating MEMORY.md and heartbeat-state.json. The only external context accessed is session history and existing memory files, which is appropriate for this purpose. It does not instruct the agent to read arbitrary system paths, credentials, or to send data to external endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — instruction-only skill. Nothing will be downloaded or installed by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables or external credentials are requested. Declared permissions are FileRead/FileWrite/FileEdit and sessions_history, which are proportionate to extracting and persisting conversation memories.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill requires write access to the agent's memory/ directory (persistent storage) and will append files and update an index; this is consistent with its function. It is not flagged as always:true. Consider the implications of persistent storage (growth, retention, and sensitive content) before enabling.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: it reads recent session history and writes summarized 'memory' files under memory/topics/ and updates MEMORY.md. Before installing, confirm you are comfortable with the agent having FileRead/FileWrite access to the memory/ directory and session history because it will persist excerpts of conversations. Decide and document retention, review, and any encryption/backups for saved memories. Test the skill in a non-sensitive conversation first to verify file naming and content format, and add a step in AGENTS.md (as suggested) only if you want automatic extraction at conversation end. If you need strict controls, restrict or audit the agent's write permission or require manual /extract-memories invocation instead of automatic triggers.
